pills.label: 2.5–4 hours
pills.pop_html: Timing: Length depends on the option you book. The route runs Al Seef, Al Fahidi and Bastakiya, the Grand Souk, the abra across the Creek, then the Spice Souk and Gold Souk in Deira. Check availability for start times.

pills.label: 7 languages
pills.pop_html: Guides: English, Arabic, French, German, Italian, Spanish and Hindi, the widest choice on this page.

pills.label: On foot, with breaks
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: A walking tour with built-in comfort breaks. Not suitable for people with mobility impairments; no luggage, large bags or pets.

pills.label: Private abra
pills.pop_html: On the water: A private traditional abra cruise on Dubai Creek with priority boarding, instead of squeezing onto a shared water-taxi crossing.

pills.label: 4 tastings
pills.pop_html: Food: Arabic coffee and tea, premium dates, Dubai chocolate and camel milk chocolate with dates, plus unlimited mineral water. Shawarma, falafel and the fresh juices come with the premium option.

pills.label: Souk price briefing
pills.pop_html: Before you shop: Before each market the guide explains real prices for gold, spices and textiles, how to haggle and the usual sales tricks, then gives you free time with no pressure to buy from set shops.

pills.label: Museum entry
pills.pop_html: Entry: Admission to the heritage sites and historic museums on the route is included, as are visits to the Textile, Spice and Gold markets.

pills.label: Most booked
pills.pop_html: Vibe: The most reviewed Old Dubai tour here: practical, relaxed pace, with hotel pickup and private-group options for families who want them.

best_for.pick_html: for first-timers who want the whole Old Dubai loop for €20, with a private abra, museum entry and a guide who tells you what gold and spices should cost before you start haggling
best_for.skip_html: if you want a full street-food meal in the base price (shawarma and falafel are premium-option only) or you only have 2 hours

items.a: Local guide, pre-market briefing, entry to heritage sites and museums, private abra with priority boarding, Arabic coffee and tea, dates, Dubai chocolate, camel milk chocolate, unlimited water, Textile, Spice and Gold market visits with shopping time.
Hotel pickup unless that option is selected.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Entrance of Al Seef Heritage Hotel by Curio, Bayt 1 (guide wears a badge), or hotel pickup if that option is booked.
English, Arabic, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Hindi.

pills.label: 2–2.5 hours
pills.pop_html: Timing: The shortest tour on this page. It starts and finishes at the Arabian Tea House in Al Fahidi, with Bastakiya, Al Seef, the abra and both Deira souks in between. Check availability for start times.

pills.label: 6 languages
pills.pop_html: Guides: English, Spanish, French, Italian, German and Portuguese, led by a senior official licensed guide.

pills.label: Mostly on foot
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: A walking tour; bring comfortable shoes, sunglasses and a sun hat. Hotel pickup comes only with the private tour option.

pills.label: 6 tastings
pills.pop_html: Food: Arabic coffee, saffron tea, dates, chocolates, local sweets and iced tea, plus water, with a tea-preparation and spices experience.

pills.label: Old houses + Baba's Cave
pills.pop_html: Entry: Entry to old Emirati houses, access to the heritage area and entry to Baba's Cave, then the Spice and Gold Souks.

pills.label: Abra across the Creek
pills.pop_html: On the water: A traditional abra, the old fishermen's boat, carries you across Dubai Creek to the Deira souks.

pills.label: Small group
pills.pop_html: Group: Run as a small-group tour, with a private option that adds hotel pickup.

pills.label: 4.9 rated
pills.pop_html: Vibe: The highest score among the big Old Dubai tours (4.93). Story-led, with a focus on dodging souk tourist traps.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers short on time who want the best-rated guide, 6 tastings and to finish back where they started, all in about 2 hours
best_for.skip_html: if you want savoury street food like shawarma or samosa, or want hotel pickup without paying for the private option

items.a: Senior licensed guide, old houses entry, heritage area access, abra ride, Baba's Cave entry, spices experience, souk access, Arabic coffee, saffron tea, dates, chocolates, local sweets, iced tea, water.
Hotel pickup (only with the private tour option).
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
In front of the Arabian Tea House Restaurant and Cafe, Al Fahidi branch (not another branch); finishes at the same place.
English, Spanish, French, Italian, German, Portuguese.

pills.label: 5 languages
pills.pop_html: Guides: English, French, German, Italian and Spanish.

pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Not suitable for children under 2, people with mobility impairments or wheelchair users. No baby strollers or large bags.

pills.label: Emirati house entry
pills.pop_html: Heritage: Entry to Al Khayma Heritage House, a historic Emirati house with a gallery of old UAE photographs, plus entry to the heritage sites and museums on the route.

pills.label: 3 tastings base
pills.pop_html: Food: Arabic coffee or tea, premium Emirati dates and camel milk chocolate, plus unlimited water. The Premium Tour adds karak and samosa, rogag and luqaimat, shawarma and falafel, lemon mint juice and camel milk ice cream.

pills.label: Souk shopping time
pills.pop_html: Souks: Textile Souk visit, then shopping time in the Spice and Gold Souks, with local shopping tips and spice and souvenir recommendations.

pills.label: Pickup option
pills.pop_html: Getting there: Meet at Al Khayma in Al Fahidi, or book the option with hotel pickup and drop-off.

pills.label: The classic route
pills.pop_html: Vibe: One of the two most-booked Old Dubai tours, with 7,775 reviews; the same Al Khayma route also comes cheaper (#5) and with full street food (#4).

best_for.pick_html: for travellers who want a real Emirati house at the start and the freedom to choose between a coffee-and-dates tour and a full street-food upgrade
best_for.skip_html: if you are bringing a baby stroller (not allowed), or you want the full food line-up without having to pick the right option

items.a: Local guide, entry to heritage sites and museums, Al Khayma Heritage House entry, Textile Souk visit, abra ride, Gold and Spice Souk shopping time, Arabic coffee or tea, dates, camel milk chocolate, unlimited water.
Tips (optional); hotel pickup unless selected.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Al Khayma Heritage Restaurant, Historical Neighbourhood, 79 Al Mussallah Rd, Al Fahidi; hotel pickup if that option is booked.
English, French, German, Italian, Spanish.

pills.label: Ages 5+

pills.label: Abra to the souks
pills.pop_html: On the water: A traditional abra across Dubai Creek to reach the Gold and Spice Souks; about 30 minutes in the Spice Souk.

pills.label: From €16

best_for.pick_html: for budget travellers who still want an Emirati heritage house, museum entry and an abra crossing, for €16
best_for.skip_html: if you have children under 5, or you want street food without remembering to add the option

pills.label: 5–6 hours
pills.pop_html: Timing: Includes pickup and drop-off time. Palm Jumeirah drive, Marina walk, Burj Al Arab and Museum of the Future photo stops, the Blue Mosque, Gold and Spice Souks (about 30 minutes each), the abra, Bastakiya, Al Khayma and the Dubai Frame.

pills.label: 5 languages
pills.pop_html: Guides: English, German, Italian, Spanish and French.

pills.label: Not for wheelchairs
pills.pop_html: Access & kids: Not suitable for wheelchair users. Most of the day is by air-conditioned vehicle, with short walks at each stop.

pills.label: Hotel pickup included
pills.pop_html: Transport: Hotel pickup and drop-off in an air-conditioned vehicle. Not available from Jebel Ali, Discovery Gardens, Investment Park, Expo City or Silicon Oasis; from there you meet at a suggested point.

pills.label: Blue Mosque visit
pills.pop_html: Inside: A guided visit to the Al Farooq Omar Bin Al Khattab (Blue) Mosque; if it is closed, the group stops outside for photos.

pills.label: Dubai Frame option
pills.pop_html: Upgrade: With the Frame option you get an entry ticket and about an hour at the Frame. Without it, the Frame is a photo stop before the drive back.

pills.label: Al Khayma visit
pills.pop_html: Heritage: A visit to Al Khayma Heritage House with Arabic tea and coffee, plus unlimited water all day.

pills.label: Old and new Dubai
pills.pop_html: Vibe: Less a souk walk, more a highlights day that includes Old Dubai. Private group option.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers who want hotel pickup and Old Dubai plus a mosque visit and the Dubai Frame in one half day, without using the metro or taxis
best_for.skip_html: if street food is the point (only tea, coffee and water are included) or you want time to explore Al Fahidi on foot

items.a: Air-conditioned transport, licensed guide, Marina walk, Blue Mosque guided tour, Burj Al Arab photo stop, Museum of the Future photo stop and ground floor, Gold and Spice Souk visit, Al Khayma heritage visit, Arabic tea and coffee, abra ride, unlimited water.
Tips (optional).
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Hotel pickup and drop-off included, except from Jebel Ali, Discovery Gardens, Investment Park, Expo City and Silicon Oasis (meet at a suggested point).
Dubai Frame entry ticket.
